content:
presales-zoe: HarborBank POC seeing TTFT spikes after ~30s of steady 60qps. p50~450ms -> p95~2.1s, occasional 429 with `prefetch_overflow`. Running Dedicated 6xA100, model=redwood/venture-7b. Can ops/eng triage?

harbor-sse: 429 body: {"error":"prefetch_overflow","retry_after_ms":800}. Logs show prefetch_wait and lock timeouts around spikes.

raj.ops: Paste sample request and recent runtime excerpt please. Also check GPU scheduler and node metrics.

presales-zoe: sample (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
Body: {"input":"...", "prefetch":true, "max_tokens":512}
```
runtime snippet:
```
2026-04-12T11:02:03Z INFO req=aa qps=64 batch_ms=88 kv_hit=0.21 prefetch_wait_ms=200
2026-04-12T11:02:04Z WARN req=bb token_tail_ms=1500 prefetch_queue_wait_ms=940
2026-04-12T11:02:05Z ERROR req=cc prefetch_lock_timeout=true
```

mai.eng: Likely cache churn -> more token work -> prefetch locks serialize and overflow queue. Short-term: ask customer to set `prefetch=false` or reduce `batch.max_delay_ms` to 25ms. Long-term: increase prefetch lock partitions and add adaptive bypass when kv_hit < 0.3.

raj.ops: I'll check node telemetry for OOMs, PCIe errors, or scheduler queuing. Harbor reported one LRU restart earlier.

presales-zoe: Customer tried `prefetch=false`: p95 improved to ~820ms but cost +15%. They want a fix that keeps cost benefits.

mai.eng: We'll run a canary: bump lock_partitions 8->20 and enable adaptive bypass threshold=0.32. Deploying to canary pool now.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: job=59782 component=runtime-prefetch-patch target=dedicated-canary-2
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: job=59782 status=running

harbor-sse: Canary live. Will report back in 20m with p50/p95 and 429 counts.

presales-zoe: Thanks. Also will share runbook to Harbor on interim steps and cost note for AE.

harbor-sse: Canary update (22m): p50=460ms p95=940ms, prefetch 429s dropped from ~10/min to 2/min, avg tokens unchanged. Looks good.

presales-zoe: Great 9. Escalating to AE/pricing for opt-in flag and planning production roll. Closing unless issues recur.
